host_guidance.system_only: A verified SYSTEM package may start and serve ordinary dialogue without private MEMORY. Do not create or claim autobiographical recall merely because core operational SQLite exists.
host_guidance.memory_available_separately: When a verified MEMORY package is separately available, attach it through the canonical memory-attach/runtime-bootstrap pipeline while the daemon is inactive, then restart and re-evaluate recall readiness.
host_guidance.memory_missing: Treat MEMORY as absent_optional in the default mode. Core runtime readiness remains independent; recall and continuity claims remain disabled.
host_guidance.memory_invalid: Keep core runtime available, fail memory readiness closed, and do not use the invalid memory source for recall.

truth_boundary: SYSTEM is executable code plus runtime contracts. MEMORY is mutable private data and may be attached, replaced or absent independently. Operational core state under workspace_runtime/core_state is not autobiographical memory and must never be used as recall evidence.
